newsitem.title: USA: State Department warns against travel to Liberia.
newsitem.headline: State Department warns against travel to Liberia.

text.p: The U.S. State Department issued a travel warning on Friday, advising U.S. citizens not to travel to Liberia.

Although West African peacekeepers had redeployed in Monrovia and reestablished the city as a safe haven, there were frequent reports of armed robberies and other crimes throughout the city, the State Department said.
Travelers outside Monrovia also faced harassment and physical violence by armed combatants manning roadblocks, it said in a statement.
